facts.text: I've recently started having trouble walking. People around me say I look drunk when I walk.
My movements feel clumsy and uncoordinated.
My right arm has less strength than it should.
It has gotten more severe over time.

facts.item: Crohn disease: resistance to standard treatments
facts.text: It hasn't responded to the standard treatments.
I'm here today for a follow-up visit for my Crohn's disease.
I've been taking natalizumab for my Crohn's for the past year.
I don't have any other symptoms.

findings.name: MRI of the brain
findings.result: Multifocal demyelinating lesions on T1/T2 images without gadolinium enhancement, consistent with progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML).

quotes.f003: Reduced strength in the right upper limb
quotes.f007: failing to respond to standard therapies

f002: The source lists 'Limb ataxia' as a secondary symptom; it is mainly an examination sign (see x007). Kept as patient-experienced clumsiness; the source does not say which limbs.
f010: From the ROS line 'No additional symptoms provided.', read as a negative review of systems (CONVERSION.md treats 'No ... provided' meta phrases as denials when they carry that meaning).

x008.source_text: Lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML). + T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML.

x008: The two MRI leaves (Findings, Comments) are one study and are merged; the source's 'Encephalopathy' is corrected to 'leukoencephalopathy' (see source_issues).

leakage.reason: The MRI result names the diagnosis (PML). This is the test's answer; the finding name does not reveal it.

source_issues: The gold label and the MRI finding read 'Progressive multifocal encephalopathy'; the disease (and the abbreviation PML) is progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy. Fixed as an obvious typo in gold.diagnosis and in the MRI result; the source wording is kept as a gold alias.
Diagnosis text is visible in Test_Results (pool flag visible_gold_alias_partitions = test_results): the MRI leaves name PML.
Vital signs are given only qualitatively ('Normothermic', 'Within normal range').
notes: 'Gait ataxia' (p002) merges with the chief complaint of difficulty walking with a 'drunken gait' (f001).
The visit is a Crohn disease follow-up (f008); the opening is the new walking problem from the chief complaint.
Crohn disease details (diagnosed 2 years ago, worsening, not responding to standard therapy) are children of f004; natalizumab is a separate medication fact.
Social history 'Information not provided.' carries no meaning and is excluded. The ROS line 'No additional symptoms provided.' is kept as a denial of other symptoms (f010).
check_coverage warns that the gold diagnosis differs from the source label. The change is deliberate: the obvious typo 'encephalopathy' is corrected to 'leukoencephalopathy' (see source_issues).

extras.objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with gait and limb ataxia, and a significant medical history.

excluded_sources.reason: 'Information not provided.' states that social history is missing; it is not a denial of anything.
